sourceNote: Original Japanese→English construction-supervisor progression. Topic map only; no lesson, audio, or production availability is implied.
foundation: Greet a crew member politely and say your name and role
Identify people on site without assuming their role
Point to a tool or material and confirm its name
Count people and common items with the right counters
Ask where a worker or object is
Distinguish a place from an action taking place there
Ask a short yes/no question and correct a mistaken item
State a simple schedule and meeting place
Ask for repetition and check what you heard
Review a short morning check-in and hand off to Core
core: Open a morning check-in and confirm attendance
Ask which trade and task each person has today
Name required protective equipment without inventing a safety rule
Ask a worker to point out a location on the site plan
Distinguish the current drawing from an older revision
Confirm a tool request and who will bring it
Count ordered materials with item-specific counters
Ask when and where a delivery is expected
Distinguish delivered, missing, and damaged materials
Set a start time and confirm a shift handoff
Assign a task using a polite request
Check that a direction was understood
Clarify whether a person or an object is in a work area
Explain a sequence with first, next, and after that
Report work in progress separately from work finished
Ask what happened yesterday using polite past forms
Report a delay without claiming an unconfirmed cause
Compare two locations or routes on a plan
Ask permission before entering a restricted area
Confirm a measurement and its unit before repeating it
Ask a supplier to repeat a quantity and delivery time
Describe a weather change and request a revised plan
Identify a concern and the person responsible for follow-up
State that an inspection is pending rather than approved
Prepare a short status update for another supervisor
Handle a worker's question without guessing the answer
Confirm a proposed change with the designated authority
Record a remaining item and its next check
Close a shift with completed and unfinished work
Run a multi-turn briefing, questions, and handoff
master: Lead a full morning briefing with late arrivals
Coordinate two trades sharing one work area
Resolve a tool shortage without changing the plan silently
Clarify a drawing discrepancy and record the answer
Check a delivery against an order and report a mismatch
Discuss an unexpected delay and a proposed recovery time
Respond to a safety concern by stopping and escalating
Explain a schedule change to another supervisor
Relay a client question without promising an unapproved answer
Prepare for an inspection and separate evidence from approval
Guide a new worker through a site orientation
Hand off an unfinished task to the next shift
Reconcile different accounts of what was completed
Ask a specialist to clarify a technical term
Explain a weather-related pause and restart condition
Give a location and observations in an emergency rehearsal
Review a punch list and assign follow-up contacts
Walk a client through confirmed and pending work
Summarize a change request with its decision still open
Lead a final briefing, questions, status, and closeout
